✨ Antique Tip of the Day ✨
Did you know Meissen porcelain was the first true hard-paste porcelain made in Europe in 1710? Before that, only China and Japan knew the secret formula! 🌸

Collectors adore Meissen for its artistry, craftsmanship, and its famous crossed swords mark—the most recognized symbol in the porcelain world. Even “seconds” with a line through the mark are treasured today!
